source.design_file: AGENTS_DESIGN.md supplied by user (feature/agents e403cab, 2026-11-02); public code takes precedence

scope: START graph and per-case candidate selection; later REPLY/PLAN stores/worker now implemented behind separate disabled AGENT_GRAPH_REVIEW_ENABLED flag. See graph_review.json for transaction/deployment boundary.

entrypoint.runner: AgentRunner with per-role models/reasoning preserved, store=False, provider POST retries disabled. Context-aware store proxy, tracing disabled.
entrypoint.result: Original RunCaseOutput: status, processing_step, input_revision, draft_ids, card_id, unresolved, steps. START rejects COMPLETE/card_id or unconfirmed/duplicate draft IDs.

mode_rules: Default false keeps legacy direct extraction and original queue/functions untouched. No .env is modified automatically.
Graph true selects GraphRuntimeRepository and GraphWorker; AGENT_STOP_AFTER_EXTRACTION is legacy-only and ignored in graph mode.
Drain legacy extraction jobs before enabling. Existing accepted requests replay their first receipt, regardless of mode. Never silently reinterpret a legacy queued job as a graph.
REPLY/PLAN supported only when AGENT_GRAPH_REVIEW_ENABLED=true and reviewed graph_review.json health capabilities are ready; default false. Sending remains separate opt-in.

stores.CaseStore/QuoteStore/AgentRunStore: GraphStore extends existing scoped AgentStore. Full quote RPC persists real quote IDs, metadata/fields, requester/item linkage without creating suppliers.
stores.CandidateStore: owner-scoped supplier_items partial-name search (five literal keywords, 31 rows), condition/evidence/supplier reads, incumbent source-mail only, actual purchase history separate from quote prices.
stores.MailDraftStore: Real immutable RFQ drafts are staged privately before user selection. Graph completion never publishes or dispatches them. API-12 atomically publishes only selected suppliers.
stores.DocumentStore: Gmail common attachment function, nodes.preprocess parsing, normalized_jsonb.documents per MIME part, no binary persistence. read_mail_part exposes stored text pages; NO_TEXT/FAILED/UNSUPPORTED preserved.
not_yet_connected: Review RPC deployment and actual provider/DB end-to-end validation

case_graph_health.rule: Read only, service-only; ready only when all signatures/grants/guards below are deployed and verified; no automatic SQL installation.

transaction: Use same POST canonical /api/v1/work-cases/{id}/start idempotency namespace and expected_revision-only normalized body hash as existing start. Check replay before current state.
Lock owned Waiting/PENDING_START case, reject already-started/archived/accepted/revision mismatch.

Persist Running/EXTRACTING, new batch, execution_mode=GRAPH_START_V1, start_from=START, initial mail ID, root execution/audit, ONE durable graph job and complete_api_request response in SAME connection/transaction.
Store entire immutable HTTP 202 {data:{case_id,input_revision,batch_id,progress_url},meta:{request_id}} before returning ACCEPTED; replay returns same body/status.

claim_case_graph_run.rule: Atomic claim with lease and exclusive token; isolated from old claim_case_extraction. Old workers must not claim graph jobs and graph workers must not claim legacy jobs.

heartbeat_case_graph_run.returns: true only for live owned job/batch/revision; renew lease for long graph runs

recover_case_graph_runs.rule: Expired graph runs -> interrupted/failed or stale without rewriting newer case. No automatic mail retransmission or rerun; unfinished staged drafts remain unsendable.

fail_case_graph_run.rule: Idempotent conditional failure for this live job only; old batch/revision never changes newer work. Lost acknowledgement after successful completion must be a no-op, not downgrade success. Codes GRAPH_FAILED, GRAPH_TIME_LIMIT, WORKER_INTERRUPTED, INPUT_REVISION_CHANGED; no raw exception/mail. Close/invalidate still-running child role records when their token expires; retain immutable completed snapshots and staged drafts as unsendable.

store_case_graph_quote.rule: Same immutable quote/evidence/NUMERIC/owner contract as existing store_case_agent_quote, but GRAPH token guard. Atomic quote+price_history+mail normalized fields+case conditions/requester+audit; preserve documents and unrelated JSON keys. Do not increment input_revision solely for extraction. Never create suppliers.

begin_case_graph_agent_run.rule: Atomic current job/owner/revision guard, distinct role execution row each call, processing_step EXTRACTING or SELECTING_CANDIDATES. Persist backend_execution_mode=GRAPH_START_V1 in input_snapshot_jsonb as backend-owned metadata, alongside role input. Append safe role progress log. No raw tool output logging.

finish_case_graph_agent_run.rule: Same owner/case/batch/run, immutable terminal record. Validated outputs are private agent_runs data. Failed partial_tool_calls/prompts/mail are discarded by backend; safe workflow logs only IDs/role/status/codes. Candidate caution is retained for completion policy checks. Role completion never sets work_cases Pending/Complete; whole-graph completion owns the business transition.

save_case_graph_document.rule: Verify source mail in owned case/current run, actual MIME part, budget and job lease. JSONB-merge normalized_jsonb.documents[p_part] without overwriting fields/item_notes or other parts. Text only; never binary/base64 or tokens. Do not advance input revision.

transaction: Lock owner/lease/revision/batch, require completed roles and actual staged draft IDs. START cannot COMPLETE/save a card.

WAITING_REPLY is a graph stop only: persist Running/CANDIDATES awaiting human selection. Bind candidate_set_id to completed CANDIDATE snapshot and selection_required=true. Do not expose any staged draft, wake sender, or claim mail.
ON_HOLD -> Pending/ON_HOLD with safe reason; partial drafts remain private. FAILED/STALE never complete or modify newer input.
Commit graph job/output/log together; API-12 independently publishes selected-only drafts under current policy. See candidate_selection.json.

stage_case_graph_draft.rule: Owner/lease/batch/revision fenced, idempotent private draft staging. Wrap internal style with producer=graph-staged-rfq-v1 and candidate_selection_required=true; record acknowledgement remains exact original agent record. Invisible to draft APIs/settings and unclaimable by senders until API-12 selects its supplier. No Gmail calls, no automatic publication after graph finish.

finish_case_graph_candidate_run.rule: One transaction verifies scope/lease/revision and completes CANDIDATE role with immutable output_jsonb.candidate_set. candidate_set_id equals p_run, review_batch_id/current batch match. All supplier/evidence/draft refs belong to this execution.

schedule_case_graph_continuations.rule: Opt-in graph mode only. Idempotently queue new START batch for already-authorized Running extraction-completed CANDIDATES/SELECTING_CANDIDATES cases, same current revision with completed INFO_EXTRACTOR. Exclude any active legacy/graph/candidate/send job or drafts; never Waiting/Confirm/Pending/accepted/archived. Original mail is reread by public START; content-dedup quote save must avoid duplicate versions. Lock scope/revision and queue selection together.

cross_host_duplicate_guard: All updated RFQ workers skip preparation for current-batch graph agent_runs marker but continue normal dispatch. DB must also reject legacy candidate preparation/writes for graph-owned batches, including old hosts without Python guard. Legacy RFQ cases may continue through old preparation. Health LEGACY_RFQ_GUARD attests this; local flag alone is insufficient.
reply_boundary: Backend REPLY/PLAN graph adapter and scoped stores are implemented opt-in; required durable scheduling/card commit RPCs remain undeployed. See graph_review.json. Keep review flag false before DB guards are verified.

verification.actual_langgraph_with_synthetic_stores: preprocess -> INFO_EXTRACTOR -> CANDIDATE -> RFQ template/persisted draft -> WAITING_REPLY
verification.published_rpc_read: All 12 graph RPC names absent in current Supabase OpenAPI (read only).

diagram_alignment.unsupported_entry_guard: START is supported; REPLY/PLAN require GRAPH_REVIEW_V1, AGENT_GRAPH_REVIEW_ENABLED and deployed review storage/queue guards. Unsupported combinations fail closed.
remaining_connection_gaps: Graph-review backend implemented, but guarded RPC deployment/integration validation is still required; see graph_review.json.
Diagram still needs human candidate selection and explicit approval/dispatch boundary.
diagram_alignment.tool_limit_authority: feature/agents app/agents/schemas.py TOOL_CALL_LIMITS; verified 2026-11-03. These are the agent-team integration targets. This backend PR neither changes app/agents nor overrides its runtime limits; current base code may differ until the agent PR is merged.

runtime_policy_override.source: 2026-11-04 PR41 review correction; supersedes previous runtime override
runtime_policy_override.policy: No temporary AGENT switches and no duplicate backend role lists. Graph START worker is optional: unavailable config/interfaces/DB/startup leaves API and mail receiver running. START follows the public graph through role2; no extraction-only fallback.
runtime_policy_override.claim: Only claim_case_graph_run(p_start_from=START). Unified START/REPLY/PLAN claim and review scheduling deferred until DB owner agreement; not called by this runtime.
runtime_policy_override.steps: Canonical agent steps SELECTING_CANDIDATES and BUILDING_PLANS. Read compatibility CANDIDATES only for persisted legacy boundary; no new writes under that alias. GENERATING_PLANS removed.
runtime_policy_override.deployment: After DB functions are deployed restart server to attach graph worker; missing graph does not prevent mail/API startup. API START still requires readiness/live worker. /ready reports mail readiness and degraded review separately.
